6064630333517660242.title: Case of Dunir Tools
6064630333517660242.description:
Tools from a race renowned for their mastery of iron and stone. They are minimally embellished but feel very durable.

This item can be delivered to the Market Commodity Vendor in a settlement to earn gold.

You can drop this item using the Drop Crate ability.
more: Packs of Fresh Produce

Some small packs of fresh locally grown produce.

This item can be delivered to the Citizen Commodity Vendor in a settlement to earn gold.

You can drop this item using the Drop Crate ability.
Ancient Aelan Wine Flagons

According to the ancient texts the Aelan were famous for their wine. Settlements all over Verra clamor for something this decadent.

This item can be delivered to the Settlement Commodity Vendor in a settlement to earn Sanctus Scrip.

You can drop this item using the Drop Crate ability.
Metal Ingots Shipment

A large shipment of metal ingots. Iron, copper, zinc, and more. These will be used for a variety of industries at the node.

This item can be delivered to the Market Commodity Vendor in a settlement to earn gold.

You can drop this item using the Drop Crate ability.

6064631034410303488.title: Crude Fishing Pole
6064631034410303488.description: Rough-hewn and river-bent, this pole won't catch kings--just legends. A first rod, or a last one.

sources.name: I need to deliver the Shoddy Granite Ashlar Blocks to a Tradesmanager.

We'll provide ye with a whole set o' tools--nae quality--but functional tools. In return, I'll have ye harvest a Wilted Snowdrop plant, bring 'em back here, an' process them ta Stale Snowdrop Powder at the Alchemy Station. We need it fer healin' salves what with all th' goblin attacks.

We'll provide ye with a whole set o' tools--nae quality--but functional tools. In return, I'll have ye harvest snowdrop plants, bring 'em back here, an' process them ta powder at the herbalism station. We need it fer healin' salves what with all th' goblin attacks.

We'll provide ye with a whole set o' tools--nae quality--but functional tools. In return, I'll have ye harvest snowdrop plants, bring 'em back here, an' process them ta powder at the herbalism station. We need it fer healin' salves what with all th' goblin attacks.

6064631121093328953.title: Dawnbreaker
6064631121093328953.description:
Flying Mount
Level 25

165% Ground Speed
215% Flying Speed
500% Maximum Health
more: Cloaked in shimmerwoven aether and kissed by the first light of the celestial dawn, the Mayoral Dawnbreaker of New Aela is no ordinary flying mount. Its form, a sublime fusion of ancient magic and primal grace, defies natural order: the musculature of a great owlbear, the ringed tail of a dusk-born rakari, and the multicolored, translucent wings of a butterfly. It is a living sigil of authority, arcana, and awe.

6064631211400168241.description: A grim, hulking slab of iron and despair, forged not from ambition or honor, but from the scraps of the dead. It's not elegant, it's not symbolic--it is the shield you raise when you have nothing left to lose.

6064631714159263748.title: Novice Major Level Prevention Enchanting Scroll
6064631714159263748.description: Required to enchant gear, prevents losing all enchanting level decrease from enchanting. The scroll may only be applied to items of equal or lower grade. Its magic remains dormant in the presence of superior equipment, refusing to activate under any circumstance.

6064631714171387912.title: Novice Blessed Enchanting Scroll
6064631714171387912.description: Required to enchant gear, multiplies success chance by 200%. The scroll may only be applied to items of equal or lower grade. Its magic remains dormant in the presence of superior equipment, refusing to activate under any circumstance.

6064631721684107271.title: Journeyman Gold Reduction Enchanting Scroll
6064631721684107271.description: Required to enchant gear, reduces gold cost of enchanting by 50%. The scroll may only be applied to items of equal or lower grade. Its magic remains dormant in the presence of superior equipment, refusing to activate under any circumstance.

6064631746073395208.title: Tattered Militia Cloak

6064631963752595457.title: Candied Flower Petals
6064631963752595457.description:
The case is full of carefully wrapped flower petals, each of which has been dipped in honey and... fried?

This item can be delivered to the Settlement Commodity Vendor in a settlement to earn Sanctus Scrip.

You can drop this item using the Drop Crate ability.
more: Case of Honeyed Meats

The roasted meat in this case has been preserved by coating it in honey and baking it after roasting.

This item can be delivered to the Settlement Commodity Vendor in a settlement to earn Sanctus Scrip.

You can drop this item using the Drop Crate ability.
Case of Dandilion Wine

A case of wine made from flower petals.

This item can be delivered to the Settlement Commodity Vendor in a settlement to earn Sanctus Scrip.

You can drop this item using the Drop Crate ability.
Crate of Ancient Slates

The slates packed in here can't be used any more, the clay and wax long since ruined by time, but you can make out a few letters here and there and collectors find that useful.

This item can be delivered to the Market Commodity Vendor in a settlement to earn gold.

You can drop this item using the Drop Crate ability.
Dunir Puzzle Stones

Each puzzle was once carved from a single stone, but now forms a series of tightly interlocked rings of various shape. Their precise construction is a lost art practiced only in New Aela and thus highly prized by the elite across the breadth of Verra.

This item can be delivered to the Market Commodity Vendor in a settlement to earn gold.

You can drop this item using the Drop Crate ability.
Crate of River Pearls

A crate of river pearls, no doubt harvested from local river mollusks. Favorite booty of pirates because they're easy to store and stash.

This item can be delivered to the Market Commodity Vendor in a settlement to earn gold.

You can drop this item using the Drop Crate ability.

6064632282473563225.title: Lucky Shoes
6064632282473563225.description: These worn leather shoes are scuffed and weathered, carrying the scent of saltwater and road-dust; yet, they fit so comfortably that they feel almost like they're not even there at all.

6064632282858258465.title: Wormwig's Ring
6064632282858258465.description: The great goblin ring. Might be a little loose of a fit. The carvings on the edge represent the destruction, and restoration of nature.

6064632282873659431.title: Snar's Bone Necklace
6064632282873659431.description: A necklace built with Snar's bones. Snar is quite the formidable force.

6064632394995400715.description: Apprentice Weaponsmithing recipe for Aeternum Captivum.

6064632577025114137.title: Malevolent Mound's Ring
6064632577025114137.description: A beautiful bronze ring crafted by one of the most skilled jewelers in Verra. The sphere at the top of the ring represents your internal burning flame. Looks as if a flame is frozen in time within the sphere.

6064632580968288242.title: The Skull of Uulorian
6064632580968288242.description: This is the skull of the mad mage, Uulorian the Many.

6064632621891321919.title: Guild War Consumable Bag
6064632621891321919.description: Grants consumables. Obtained by winning Guild War

6064632621892042818.title: Guild War Consumable Bag

6064632699354485548.title: Ashen Flame Orders
6064632699354485548.description: A weathered parchment, rough to the touch with frayed edges. The paper shows signs of frequent handling and is folded unevenly. At the center, a crimson wax seal bears a jagged mark, hastily pressed. The black ink is sharp, with some bleeding in places. Crude twine holds the scroll together.

6064632733942022154.title: Insulated Braithreach Shirt
6064632733942022154.description: Living flames powered the smelters in Braithreach. Their tempers flared often enough that thicker workwear became commonplace.

6064632735024480268.title: Recipe: Aggrieved Plateshaper's Skivvies
6064632735024480268.description: Journeyman Leatherworking recipe for Aggrieved Plateshaper's Skivvies

6064632735111446547.title: Recipe: Slagbreaker Miner's Skivvies
6064632735111446547.description: Journeyman Leatherworking recipe for Slagbreaker Miner's Skivvies.

6064632738997338113.title: Siege Declaration Banner - Halcyon
6064632738997338113.description:
A level 15 or above player can use this banner to declare a siege against Halcyon.

Seek out a stone platform near the marketplace of Halcyon to place this banner.

6064632739857301513.title: Dunzentine Focus
6064632739857301513.description: Old Dunzen forging techniques were the greatest in recorded history. To recover even a mundane piece made during the height of their forgecraft is a windfall for any adventurer.

6064632745325625367.title: Hornhexer's Bone
more: A bone with an odd shape. Vital to the creation of "Hornhexer's Headband".

6064632745595830510.title: The Eye of Esh
6064632745595830510.description: A large red gem exquisitely cut into the shape of an eye. It glows intensely and emits a searing heat. This is of divine craftsmanship.

sources.name: Upon closer inspection you divulge that this is a concealed compartment. It appears to be locked.

6064632746595188961.title: Purifier Cloak
6064632746595188961.description: Before the apocalypse, Purifiers often found themselves in contention with horrors beyond reckoning. Though diminished in modern times, their armor still boasts wards against those evils.

6064632750916829185.title: Blood of the Conscript
6064632750916829185.description:
Drop: Tapmaster Percheh 
Ingredient In: Weaponsmithing
more: A precious few drops of a terrible, terrible fluid.

6064632750950514699.title: Harrowed Stars Ring
6064632750950514699.description: Proximity to the ancient capital meant that The Church of the Seven Stars had the space and wealth to construct elaborate shrines to each of the seven gods. Even lesser clerics and temple staff wore symbols of their faith in semi-precious metals and gems.

6064632751326232591.title: Braithreach Stompers
6064632751326232591.description: Thick, greasy soot cakes the once-sturdy leather of these insulated boots. A gritty residue coats their firebrick soles, and the faint metallic scent of the Braithreach smelters clings to them despite their apparent long abandonment.

6064632756817035298.title: Recovered Vaelune Artifact
6064632756817035298.description: Remnants of a life; Fragments of desert pottery, scraps of old cloth - perhaps from a wall hanging or a rug.

6064633107379585027.title: Crate of Squall's End Incense
6064633107379585027.description:
This item can be delivered to the Guild Commodity Vendor in a node to earn Guild XP.

You can drop this item using the Drop Crate ability.
more: Box of Poppy Seed Cakes

A box of poppy seed cakes.  Tightly and individually wrapped to preserve freshness.

This item can be delivered to the Market Commodity Vendor in a settlement to earn gold.

You can drop this item using the Drop Crate ability.
Crate of Sandalwood Footstools

Delicately packed expertly crafted sandalwood footstools with upholstered cusions.

This item can be delivered to the Citizen Commodity Vendor in a settlement to earn gold.

You can drop this item using the Drop Crate ability.
Crate of Silk Veils

Delicate veils of beautifully spun silk, gently layered in a crate.

This item can be delivered to the Settlement Commodity Vendor in a settlement to earn Sanctus Scrip.

You can drop this item using the Drop Crate ability.
Crate of Lens Blanks

The inside of this crate contains several finely crafted gold bangles.  Inlaid with gems, these upper arm pieces of jewelry are highly sought after by the affluent.

This item can be delivered to the Market Commodity Vendor in a settlement to earn gold.

You can drop this item using the Drop Crate ability.
Chest of Perfume Bottles

Expertly packed chest containing silk wrapped glass bottles of perfume.  Their spicy floral scents are a favorite of the Vaelune people.

This item can be delivered to the Market Commodity Vendor in a settlement to earn gold.

You can drop this item using the Drop Crate ability.

6064633112807669776.title: Al'Ashal's Quill
6064633112807669776.description: This is the quill that the legendary poet, Al'Ashal, used to write his first poem of the Sandsquall Scrolls.

6064633135983296596.description: Apprentice Leatherworking recipe for Scarhide Mantle

6064633191993966611.title: Prototype Hunting Bow
6064633191993966611.description: An iconic tool used solely by hunters. A great bow to begin your hunting journey with.

6064633221397217305.title: Bird of Paradise
6064633221397217305.description:
Gather: Turquoise Sea, Jundark 
Ingredient In: Alchemy, Weaving

6064633259572002818.title: Giant Fern
6064633259572002818.description:
Gather: Turquoise Sea, Jundark 
Ingredient In: Alchemy

6064633271733256256.title: Ashbrand Dagger
6064633271733256256.description: Wrapped in fraying cord and shaped with care, this knife seems more tool than weapon, until it is neither.

6064633271736270920.title: Forsaken Daggers
6064633271736270920.description: Once, during the Siege of Whispering Walls, the Sons' armored charge faltered. Quick as shadows, the rogues Finn and Raze, twin daggers flashing, slipped through a culvert. They quickly and quietly dispatched the guard, disabled the gate mechanism from within, and let the main force flood in.

6064633271744856156.title: Jackal's Knives
6064633271744856156.description: The Obsidian Jackals engraved their symbol into every gem which passed through the syndicate. Jackals Knives were a symbol of the authority they commanded in the desert.

6064633272382652417.title: Silverglade Baleblades
6064633272382652417.description: Bronze Baleblades, etched with symbols of sacrifice, were historically used in pairs by Toren cultists in their secretive blood-rites. When wielded in synchronized movements, they create a mesmerizing dance, binding stron energies that inspire both awe and terror.

Drop: Voidspeaker Telmont 
Ingredient In: Arcane Engineering
more: A vitreous mixture composed of crushed glass, flux, and silicate granules, integral to the Vaelune lampworking art that produced lachrymatory vessels and glass jewelry.

6064633289012346908.title: Unquenched Cinder
6064633289012346908.description:
Drop: Aria the Flamebearer 
Ingredient In: Arcane Engineering
more: This curious cinder is the size of a marble. A mesmerizing dance of orange and red hues flickers across its surface, and while you feel its heat, it does not scorch your hand.

6064633289596731472.title: Hardend Chitin Armor
6064633289596731472.description: Forged from colossal desert scorpion chitin, this armor's plated shell is light and resilient. Traces of the creature's venom still seep from its joints.

6064633289847276005.title: Necromancer's Guide to Puppetry
6064633289847276005.description: Kesetal approached the corpse with one goal in mind. Looking gleefully into the eye of the dead cyclops, he consulted the instructions once more. "Make a large incision around the eyelids, preserve the eyestalk as much as possible, steam the organ in boiling blood, and let it rest in a jar for three moons."

6064633295353872423.description: Elbow deep in Brightmound's wide gaping mouth, the treasure hunter found a pearl the size of a crystal ball. "This ought to cost at least an arm, if not a leg.."

6064633299995459589.description: This eye retains its molten focus, a remnant of the queen's extinguished fury.

6064633300667531302.title: Stockade Sack
more: Property of Direhold Stockade. Early attempts at crossing through the Divine Gateway were performed by prisoners. Each was given a sack of survival rations. These small sacks can still be found being traded as uncommon packs with limited holding space.

6064633300672905255.title: The Token of the Pack
more: Granted to those that have proven their alliance to Tura'Madu, the Token of the Pack was rumored to bestow greater protection from toxins.

6064633408276398083.title: Apprentive Ashen Sifts
6064633408276398083.description: A fine glimmering powder, oddly cool to the touch. As it is stirred or poured sparks of active essence flicker and flare within.

6064633408298745864.title: Journeyman Glintic Residuum - Weapon
6064633408298745864.description: A spectral wisp of magic's purest form, bound to no master, resides within these fragments of unusually volatile Glint.

6064633408302481419.title: Novice Glintic Residuum - Artisan
6064633408302481419.description: A spectral wisp of magic's purest form, bound to no master, resides within these fragments of unusually volatile Glint.

6064633413779718147.title: Guild War Defectors Declaration Scroll - Sandsquall Desert
6064633413779718147.description:
DISABLED WHILE INVESTIGATING ISSUES
A Guild Master may consume this scroll to declare war on another Guild.

Defector and Rebel camps will be unconvered. Destroy the Defectors and protect the Rebels to gain victory points.

The first guild to reach 500 victory points win.

6064633419021615109.title: Novice Tempering Kit - Accessory
6064633419021615109.description:
A small, sturdy wooden box, polished to a soft sheen. Inside, nestled in compartments lined with dark velvet, are collected the required elements of magical enchantment. The lid is adorned with a small emblem, signifying the type of gear the kit is designed to enhance.
This kit can only be used on equipment of equal or lesser grade than itself; attempts to temper higher-tier gear are magically inhibited and cannot even be initiated.

6064633430593963162.title: Webwell Fangs
more: These long, curved fangs, shine with a natural ivory sheen. Each retains a trace of venom, and this residual danger adds a sinister allure to weapons crafted from them.

6064633430595732637.title: Hollow Bone
6064633430595732637.description:
Drop: Shrill-Master Gallea 
Ingredient In: Leatherworking
more: Kreeok bones, known for their lightweight, durable structure can be woven betwixt splints of bone or steel to offer excellent protection while remaining light enough to allow the wearer to remain agile.

6064633430598157473.title: Thalora's Lash
6064633430598157473.description:
Drop: Thalora Thrice-Damned 
Ingredient In: Jeweler
more: A single strand of hair, long, ink-black, and stiffened with dried blood and old magic, its root still scorched where power once surged. Despite its frailty, it won't burn, nor will it break.

6064633447846838436.title: Vinemail Vest
6064633447846838436.description: Those who cared for the forgotten garden of King Atrax are fated to fertilize the ground. For one, he became the garden! Caretakers. This is the Guardner, a defender veiled in the trapping of arcane overgrowth.

6064633454046020053.title: Recipe: Iron Wing Hood
6064633454046020053.description: Journeyman Leatherworking recipe for Iron Wing Hood.

6064633457857527814.title: Crate of Crystal Infused Coconut Milk
6064633457857527814.description:
A delicacy, once rumored to enhance vitality and charisma, now reduced to a luxury item flaunted by the noble class.

This item can be delivered to the Citizen Commodity Vendor in a settlement to earn gold.

You can drop this item using the Drop Crate ability.
more: Case of Reefglass Mirrors

It's a barrel of mirrors in various shapes and sizes.

This item can be delivered to the Settlement Commodity Vendor in a settlement to earn Sanctus Scrip.

You can drop this item using the Drop Crate ability.
Crate of Pearl Tea

Brewed from sun-dried sea blooms, turning the water used to a pearl color.

This item can be delivered to the Market Commodity Vendor in a settlement to earn gold.

You can drop this item using the Drop Crate ability.
Crate of Sunscale Leather Scraps

The crate contains scraps of sunscale leather used in various

This item can be delivered to the Market Commodity Vendor in a settlement to earn gold. 

You can drop this item using the Drop Crate ability.
Crate of Kelp Robes

The crate contains kelp robes, woven with kelp.

This item can be delivered to the Citizen Commodity Vendor in a settlement to earn gold.

You can drop this item using the Drop Crate ability.
Barrel of Driftwood Incense

It's a barrel of Incense made from driftwood.

This item can be delivered to the Settlement Commodity Vendor in a settlement to earn Sanctus Scrip.

You can drop this item using the Drop Crate ability.

6064633509484756993.description: Boost your lumberjacking skills with the Survey Pylon! This device creates a special area that enhances your woodcutting efficiency while you remain within its glow.

6064633527215325619.title: Sparkveil Hood
6064633527215325619.description: Draws low over the brow, casting the eyes in shadow while leaving the view clear to watch the dance of flame and steel.

6064633527217029622.title: Sparkveil Sash
6064633527217029622.description: Binds the layers in place with a single knot, the ends shifting lightly as though stirred by the forge's warm breath.

6064633764670301235.title: Voidbreak Mining Pickaxe
6064633764670301235.description: Crafted from materials found in the extreme heat and pressure of the Pit of Golgora, the Voidbreak is the most eccentric choice for the adventurous artisan. The pickaxe is uniquely proficient for cutting the obsidian-rich formations surrounding the Heart of the Jungle. Although it appears like any other tool of similar quantity, there's something compelling about the specialty steel. It fractures volcanic glass into prismatic shards, a shape you might have seen somewhere else before.

6064633769313173638.title: Rune-Etched Plate
6064633769313173638.description: This is a thick ceramic plate that was once bound to a Clayborn Guardian. A trace of essence dances within the grooves of the runes.

6064633776352919670.title: Oathfall Monolith
6064633776352919670.description: The sacred scriptures of the Light Pact are all but a faint memory among the Exalted.

6064633786061357067.title: Branded Flesh
6064633786061357067.description: The patch of thick hide carries a large brand upon it. It is a telling clue of the traditions of the mysterious Ramkin.

6064633855522111540.title: Salvewort
6064633855522111540.description:
Gather: Anvils 
Ingredient In: Alchemy, Weaving

6064633860905959424.title: Mining Construction Supplies
6064633860905959424.description:
A sturdy, reinforced crate brimming with coarse stone, raw metals, and glittering uncut gems. Essential for foundational and structural components. 

This item may be contributed to settlement construction projects in exchange for Sanctus Script. In addition, citizens will receive settlement reputation for their contributions.

You can drop this item using the Drop Crate ability.
more: Lumberjacking Construction Supplies

A heavy crate bound with iron bands, filled with raw timber and rough-hewn planks straight from the forest. Vital for framing and wooden structures. 

This item may be contributed to settlement construction projects in exchange for Sanctus Script. In addition, citizens will receive settlement reputation for their contributions.

You can drop this item using the Drop Crate ability.
Hunting Construction Supplies

A blood-stained crate containing unrefined animal hides, bones, and sinew. Ideal for crafting rugged components and primitive reinforcements. 

This item may be contributed to settlement construction projects in exchange for Sanctus Script. In addition, citizens will receive settlement reputation for their contributions.

You can drop this item using the Drop Crate ability.
Herbalism Construction Supplies

A woven crate packed with fragrant herbs, pliable vines, and dense foliage. Useful for insulation, binding agents, and natural reinforcements. 

This item may be contributed to settlement construction projects in exchange for Sanctus Script. In addition, citizens will receive settlement reputation for their contributions.

You can drop this item using the Drop Crate ability.
Fishing Construction Supplies

A salt-sprayed crate laden with fishbones, driftwood, and coarse sea grasses. Suited for shoreline structures and maritime settlements. 

This item may be contributed to settlement construction projects in exchange for Sanctus Script. In addition, citizens will receive settlement reputation for their contributions.

You can drop this item using the Drop Crate ability.
Tanning Construction Supplies

A tightly sealed crate filled with treated hides, cured leather, and pungent tanning agents. Integral for resilient bindings and surface coverings. 

This item may be contributed to settlement construction projects in exchange for Sanctus Script. In addition, citizens will receive settlement reputation for their contributions.

You can drop this item using the Drop Crate ability.

6064633860905959432.title: Stonechant Cowl
6064633860905959432.description: Fit for those who addressed caverns as kin and expected reply.

sources.name: A Magical Bag Of Mixed Goodies

6064633860906680331.title: Thornway Accord Treads
6064633860906680331.description: Marks left in soft earth vanish by dawn, even to the tracker who made them.

6064633860906680333.title: Thornway Accord Bindings
6064633860906680333.description: Tightens in the presence of overgrown stone, especially where carvings once lay.

6064633860907139091.title: Oathdelve Vestment
6064633860907139091.description: Worn by those whose oaths required them to remain unseen but never absent.

6064633860907139098.title: Oathdelve Cowl
6064633860907139098.description: Light does not linger near the edges, and reflections often look away.

6064633860908187683.title: Tithebrook Hood
6064633860908187683.description: Hooded low, it softens the voice to something halfway between apology and demand.

6064633860908646440.title: Hallowmark Bindings
6064633860908646440.description: The markings remain clear even when worn away, legible only to those who regret.

6064633860908646442.title: Hallowmark Grips
6064633860908646442.description: Fingers twitch while inside them, but never when watched.

6064633860910350391.title: Starlight Creed Chestplate
6064633860910350391.description: Forged where lanternlight slips through salt-stained beams, this chestplate carries the quiet conviction of those who sail without waking the sea. Its weight is measured in secrets kept beneath the waves.

6064633860910350398.title: Starlight Creed Helm
6064633860910350398.description: Formed with the curve of ocean dusk in mind, this helm casts vision through a softened lens. Thoughts drift with the current, quiet and unhindered.

6064633860910743616.title: Scorchwander Breastplate
6064633860910743616.description: Etched with patterns drawn from wind-cut dunes, this breastplate holds the memory of stillness before a storm. It feels light when the horizon blurs, as though attuned to the long silence between footsteps.

6064633860910743621.title: Scorchwander Gloves
6064633860910743621.description: Stitched with thread that never frays, these gloves carry the grain of forgotten oaths. They grip with certainty even when the air begins to shimmer.

6064633860910743623.title: Scorchwander Helm
6064633860910743623.description: This helm carries the stillness of desert nights and the echo of names spoken only once. It feels cooler the closer one stands to flame.

6064633860915921048.title: Cindermarch Helm
6064633860915921048.description: Crowns the head in a shape that blends defense with visibility, the brow angled to keep both glare and grit from the eyes.

6064633860917166259.title: Veilrender Helm
6064633860917166259.description: Its visor narrows the world to slits of perception, guarding against the bite of thorn or the surprise of sudden movement.

6064633860917887156.title: Ferncloak Cape
6064633860917887156.description: Spills in layered folds that mirror the curve of fern fronds after rain, swaying gently as the wearer moves through leaf and shadow.

6064633860917887163.title: Ferncloak Belt
6064633860917887163.description: Keeps every piece drawn close, the tension set so nothing shifts whether in quiet watch or quick pursuit.

6064633860918411461.title: Slagwalker Helm
6064633860918411461.description: A deep-crowned guard with narrow eye slits, its form reminiscent of the vent towers that rise from the foundry halls.

6064633860919066839.title: Dunecoil Helm
6064633860919066839.description: Keeps the gaze shaded and the face guarded, the brow angled to deflect both the sun's glare and the incoming strike.

6064633860919525599.title: Gloomraider Belt
6064633860919525599.description: Binds the armor in place with a balanced fit, the ties held secure so nothing shifts when the raid is in motion.

6064633860920312034.title: Wildmarch Jerkin
6064633860920312034.description: Layered for the long road, its surface bears faint stains of old journeys, each mark a memory of the miles behind.

6064633860920574194.title: Coalhewn Helm
6064633860920574194.description: Crowns the head in a low, sturdy profile, the brow sloped to shed both falling dust and a sudden strike.

6064633860947050787.title: Deepward Bastion Bracers
6064633860947050787.description: Riveted with overstone rivulets, these bracers held fast in the crush where light had no place. They creak faintly, as if recalling the last command given before the tunnels collapsed.

6064633860947050791.title: Deepward Bastion Pauldrons
6064633860947050791.description: Layered and blunt, these shoulders once bore the weight of clan banners dusted in soot and sorrow. Beneath their arc lies the echo of names too sacred to speak aloud.

6064633860948164917.title: Undermarch Vambraces
6064633860948164917.description: Trimmed in dull steel and stamped with threefold oaths, these forearm guards were forged for those who carried both message and hammer. They cool swiftly when held near silence.

6064633860949147975.title: Crownbreaker Bracers
6064633860949147975.description: Etched with riverbranch sigils and char marks from rebel forges, these bracers were meant to shield both flesh and vow. They flex with the memory of torchlit strikes beneath weeping willows.

6064633860949147977.title: Crownbreaker Helm
6064633860949147977.description: Forged in secrecy beneath the vaulted stone of forgotten sanctuaries, this helm offers no crest. The inside bears a scratched map, not of land, but of debts.

6064633860971561309.title: Stormcanon Pauldrons
6064633860971561309.description: Curved like the wings of distant seabirds and set wide as a vessel's beam, these pauldrons carry the hush of oncoming storms. Their weight does not burden but balances, as if tuned to the pitch of unseen tides.

6064633860971823456.title: Sunwrought Chestplate
6064633860971823456.description: Forged in reverence to forgotten city-kings and their djinn-bound guardians, this chestplate hums faintly in dry air, as if listening for the echoes of lost commands beneath the mirage.

6064633860971823461.title: Sunwrought Greaves
6064633860971823461.description: Etched with the winding paths of ancient pilgrims, these greaves hold fast in drifting sands and echo with the silence of those who never returned.

6064633860971823463.title: Sunwrought Faulds
6064633860971823463.description: These weighted folds of protection carry the memory of battle chants once sung beneath blazing skies, their rhythms etched into every layered contour like verses from a vanished age.

6064633860983685551.title: Brienplate Tassets
6064633860983685551.description: Shaped to guard the stride of the deep's chosen, these plates rest with the quiet strength of the seabed itself. Their form carries the memory of fleets that met the storm and were not found again, a reminder that the ocean shields its own as fiercely as it takes.

6064633860983947703.title: Sunbastion Pauldrons
6064633860983947703.description: Stand from the shoulders like the watchtowers of a sunlit keep, deflecting the strike and marking the presence of the guard.

6064633860984747291.title: Runic Sigil
6064633860984747291.description: A round, flat sigil carved from dusky red stone. On one side, an inscription of a rune is engraved onto the surface.

6064633860985061831.title: Ironwake Helm
6064633860985061831.description: Encircles the head like the crown of a bastion tower, keeping the bearer's sight sharp and their mind unmoved by the clash around them.

6064633860985717195.title: Coralhold Cape
6064633860985717195.description: Falls in slow arcs like the banners of a reef-kingdom, its folds stirring with the quiet confidence of currents that have carved stone into beauty and strength over ages untold.

6064633860985717197.title: Coralhold Sabatons
6064633860985717197.description: Every step moves with the assurance of a mariner walking the decks of a vessel hewn for storms, finding balance even where the world shifts beneath him.

6064633860986044888.title: Scaldplate Gauntlets
6064633860986044888.description: Grip with the surety of a craftsman's tools, their hold steady even when the air shimmers and the skin burns.

6064633860987224555.title: Stoneglen Helm
6064633860987224555.description: Crowns the head as a hillfort crowns its rise, the gaze beneath steady over field and foe.

6064633860987486705.title: Anvilguard Boots
6064633860987486705.description: Step after step, the stone answers. They grip the ground with a miner's certainty, carrying the wearer sure-footed over ice, shale, and scree.

6064633860987486707.title: Anvilguard Gauntlets
6064633860987486707.description: Made for the grasp that will not falter, these gauntlets take the strength of the mountain and set it into the hands.

6064633860987945464.title: Reefguard Cape
6064633860987945464.description: Billows like a tide-washed banner above the shallows, carrying the salt-bright air of waters that have never known defeat.

6064633860987945466.title: Reefguard Treads
6064633860987945466.description: Step with the assurance of a warden walking the reef crest, finding solid hold among the slick stone and foaming spray.

6064633860988666375.title: Sandbastion Greaves
6064633860988666375.description: They keep the stride sure even when the ground shifts and slides, each step pressed deep into the certainty of purpose.

6064633860988666377.title: Sandbastion Tassets
6064633860988666377.description: Guard the upper legs with layered plates that echo the tiered walls of desert keeps, shielding what must remain unbroken.

6064633860997710355.title: Emberwake Cowl
6064633860997710355.description: No face beneath it is ever recognized twice by the same watcher.

sources.name: A Magical Bag Of Mixed Goodies

6064633860998562345.title: Runebreath Vestment
6064633860998562345.description: Once worn by those who etched verses into smoke and cast their meanings into stone.

6064633860999479869.title: Candlefen Bindings
6064633860999479869.description: Wrapped to keep rites from bleeding outward, or something else from bleeding in.

6064633861005247062.title: Shell of the Sanctifier Brigandine
6064633861005247062.description: The front bears a softened imprint, as though shaped to protect a heart too long exposed to the desert's silence. Veins of ancient thread run beneath its surface, whispering vows made beneath mirage-lit moons.

6064633861005587741.title: Runic Sigil
6064633861005587741.description: A round, flat sigil carved from dusky red stone. On one side, an inscription of a rune is engraved onto the surface.

6064633861010162334.title: Seafoam Jerkin
6064633861010162334.description: Light and unbinding, it moves with the body as naturally as the current moves around a swimmer, granting freedom on deck or along the shore.

6064633861010162336.title: Seafoam Bracers
6064633861010162336.description: Rest lightly on the forearms, shedding water with each movement, their curve recalling the arc of a wave cresting.

6064633861010752173.title: Shadeweft Leggings
6064633861010752173.description: Cut for quiet strides and low stances, they flow with the body through brambles and hanging vines.

6064633861012259522.title: Glimmersoot Jerkin
6064633861012259522.description: Close-fitted for swift work and quick steps, its layers keep the weight low while guarding against the stray spark or sudden strike.

6064633861012718292.title: Veilsand Jerkin
6064633861012718292.description: Light and close to the frame, it moves with the body in the steady rhythm of a traveler crossing long stretches without pause.

6064633861014029037.title: Ashveil Shoulders
6064633861014029037.description: Lie close to the frame, their subtle curve adding protection without slowing the turn of the body.

6064633861014291195.title: Seawisp Gloves
6064633861014291195.description: Close with a sailor's practiced grip, steady even when the air is thick with salt and spray.

6064633861014553343.title: Duneflare Shoulders
6064633861014553343.description: Light and close to the frame, they give just enough cover to meet a sudden strike without slowing the turn of the torso.

6064633866781655090.title: Fireveined Ring
6064633866781655090.description: Dark metal laced with ember toned threads, the glow deepens when the band turns, like coals stirred to life.

6064633866783031353.title: Veilpierced Ring
6064633866783031353.description: A thin circle marked with tiny notches that align only at certain turns, as if parting a curtain the eye cannot see.

6064633866784604225.title: Duneburied Earring
6064633866784604225.description: Dust-soft textures remain in every groove, a memory of long sleep beneath traveling sand. When the wind rises, it carries a hint of dry spice and distant caravan bells.

6064633866788339782.title: Wavetossed Necklace
6064633866788339782.description: Knotted links rise and fall in a pattern like small swells, bright where the curve turns toward imagined sun.

6064633866788798537.title: Djinnblessed Necklace
6064633866788798537.description: A narrow pendant worked with looping script, warm to the touch as sunlit stone. It seems to listen when the wind falls quiet.

6064633866789257292.title: Shadebound Necklace
6064633866789257292.description: A narrow shard dark as water under canopy, cut to swallow stray glints until only shape remains.

6064633866803937358.title: Rusty Spear
6064633866803937358.description: The shaft is covered with speckled rust, yet this spear's tip is still strong and polished.  Whether from care or from use, there is no doubt this spear has been maintained to pierce through all obstacles.

6064633866937040979.title: Verdant Oath Hand Axe
6064633866937040979.description: Grown from grafted root and bound in bark-hardened iron, the Verdant Oath Hand Axe smells faintly of sap and storm. Moss gathers along its spine no matter the climate, and vines left near it tend to bloom out of season.

6064633867064967279.title: Dreadwake Axe
6064633867064967279.description: Its bite recalls drowned corridors and riverblack gloom, a shape honed for work done where light does not endure.

6064633867080564852.title: Ironhearth Great Axe
6064633867080564852.description: Cast in the heart-fires beneath Mount Dun and quenched in slag-slick cisterns, the Ironhearth Great Axe holds a stubborn, unyielding weight. It rings like struck stone when drawn, and its edge will not dull unless the mountain forgets its name.

6064633867095965843.title: Dreadwake Great Axe
6064633867095965843.description: A river-cut silhouette that parts shadow as water, balanced for the long pull through gloom and root.

6064633867113463972.title: Sunscorch Great Grimoire
6064633867113463972.description: Sun toned margins hold a faint mirage blur, the text dark and calm against the light.

6064633867171725513.title: Mistwood Focus
6064633867171725513.description: Always faintly damp, the Mistwood Focus seems to draw fog from the air around it. When held, nearby leaves sometimes stir, even without wind.

6064633867180507359.title: Dreadwake Focus
6064633867180507359.description: Dark metal with smooth edges, like river stones long turned in shadowed currents.

6064633867187257584.title: Pyrebrand Longbow
6064633867187257584.description: Dark red streaks trace the curve, like veins of cooling forge-fire.

6064633867254694282.title: Runeweld Shortbow
6064633867254694282.description: Bound with faded runes and carved from dark ash, the Runeweld Shortbow looses with a sharp note that echoes longer than it should. Its grip warms near ancient stone.

6064633867255087499.title: Coralblade Shortbow
6064633867255087499.description: Salt-etched and smooth as driftglass, it hums with tension pulled from reefs that do not welcome the surface world.

6064633867263017377.title: Stoneforge Spear
6064633867263017377.description: Straight as quarried line and unyielding in motion, the Stoneforge Spear lands with the certainty of a measured blow. It leaves clean punctures and carries the scent of dry dust.

6064633867270488500.title: Glorybound Spear
6064633867270488500.description: Worn in the Riverlands' long marches, its balanced form feels made for destiny's hand.

6064633867271078327.title: Mirageborn Spear
6064633867271078327.description: Its lines blur at the edges, shifting like desert visions that tempt the lost.

6064633867276648902.title: Coralblade Sword
6064633867276648902.description: Balanced to glide like a manta through shallows, its weight guided by the pull of unseen tides.

6064633895711146046.title: Mount Cosmetic: Brew Bear
6064633895711146046.description: This cosmetic will override the visual look of your ground mount.
more: This massive brown bear is no mere beast of burden. It is a walking tavern and loyal companion. Raised from cubhood by resourceful homesteaders, the Brew Bear hauls kegs of hearty seasonal ale in carved casks strapped to its flanks. Though gentle to those it knows, its sheer size and speed make it a formidable deterrent to would-be thieves. Few sights are more welcome or intimidating than this shaggy giant plodding through the snow, kegs sloshing and breath steaming.

6064633895754858580.title: Cosmetic: The Exultant One
6064633895754858580.description: This cosmetic will override the visual look of specific mounts when you equip it.

6064633895755055189.title: Mount Cosmetic: Steed of Soaring Scarlet
6064633895755055189.description: This cosmetic will override the visual look of your flying mount.
more: A blaze of crimson streaking across sky and field, the Steed of Soaring Scarlet is as fearless as it is flamboyant. With wings that shimmer like silk and hooves that barely touch the ground, it serves as a radiant and untamed flying mount for those bold enough to keep pace.

6064633895776813152.title: Cosmetic: Wretched Rafflesia
6064633895776813152.description: This cosmetic will override the visual look of specific mounts when you equip it.

6064633895782187109.title: Mount Cosmetic: Graveyard Golem
6064633895782187109.description: This cosmetic will override the visual look of your ground mount.
more: Forged from broken grave markers and held together by mourning rites, the Graveyard Golem moves like a mausoleum on legs. Each step stirs dust from forgotten names, and each breathless pause carries the hush of hallowed ground. It is less a mount than a pact with memory, a monument that walks so the past is never buried.

6064633895782318182.title: Cosmetic: Living Wave
6064633895782318182.description: This cosmetic will override the visual look of specific mounts when you equip it.

6064633895797719148.title: Cosmetic: Rock Hawk
6064633895797719148.description: This cosmetic will override the visual look of specific mounts when you equip it.

6064633895798243439.title: Mount Cosmetic: Guarden
6064633895798243439.description: This cosmetic will override the visual look of your ground mount.
more: A towering tangle of vine and muscle, the Guarden was first grown by ancient feykin to guard sacred groves. Now repurposed as a living mount, it carries its rider with deliberate steps and quiet strength. Beneath the petals and moss lies a beast of staggering power, moving only to protect what must never be defiled.

6064633895810564213.title: Mount Cosmetic: Dynasty Beetle
6064633895810564213.description: This cosmetic will override the visual look of your ground mount.
more: Clad in lacquered plates and crowned with imperial color, the Dynasty Beetle is a living relic of old glory. Once used by royal courts to carry envoys and banners across sun-drenched roads, these massive insects still carry themselves with silent poise and unwavering discipline. Though slow to provoke, they are fiercely protective of their riders and capable of remarkable endurance. A symbol of bygone power, the Dynasty Beetle remains a noble companion for those who value tradition and quiet strength.

6064633900518998031.title: Mistwood Grovecleaver
6064633900518998031.description: Shaped from timber felled under moonless skies and bound with iron cooled in root-choked springs, the Mistwood Grovecleaver bears faint rings along its blade like the growth of trees. When left in still air, leaves sometimes turn in its direction. It is said the forest remembers its edge, and does not always object to its use.

6064633900934496583.title: Stormcurrent Tideshaper Focus

6064633901035684193.title: Wavecutter Spraystring Shortbow

6064634460492006017.title: Veinspike Resin
more: A viscous, black resin harvested from the roots of deep-earth fungi that grow in mineral-rich caverns. When applied to stone, it seeps into microfissures and splits rock with slow, deliberate pressure, exposing ore veins without harming their integrity.

6064634489924157444.title: Lumen of the Unwritten Verse
6064634489924157444.description: Soft light glows within this unclosed device, as if cradling a syllable that refuses to be born. Its rings drift around a hollow core, never touching, never still. Traces of forgotten script scroll across its facets in no known language, fading before they can be seen twice. It pulses with rhythm but no meter ? the heartbeat of a thought unfinished. To hold it is to listen for a voice that has not yet decided what it will say.

6064634489925861382.title: The Barnacle Gospel
6064634489925861382.description: Heavy and slick, this tome feels less carried than clutched, as though it pulls toward the earth with the weight of drowned truths. Its cover pulses faintly, the rhythm of a tide that has long forgotten the shore. Barnacle-like growths ring the spine, and when opened, briny steam spills from its pages. The script within writhes like reef-eels in moonlight, twisting through diagrams of muscle and sinew as if to rewrite the body in worship of the abyss. Each passage lands with the force of tidal ruin, not in words, but in undertow.

6064634500686348288.title: Harpoon Launcher

6064634518650093670.title: Glasscore of the Lost Meridian
6064634518650093670.description: This object is smooth, spherical, and almost translucent, but impossible to see through. It refracts the air around it, bending heat and distance into impossible angles. Thin filaments drift just beneath its surface, forming a compass that never points in the same direction twice. It trembles faintly when held in direct sun, as if resisting a memory too bright to endure.

6064634518670147736.title: Treads of the Absent Path
6064634518670147736.description: The soles of these boots are smooth and unfinished, as though they were never meant to arrive anywhere. Veins of dark filament crisscross their surface, pulsing faintly. Around the ankle, fine ridges form the outline of a route not taken, worn deeper the longer one stands still.
